title: Development and Testing of a Patient-facing Educational Tool About Liver Cancer Prevention
official: Development and Testing of a Patient-facing Educational Tool About Liver Cancer Prevention
summary: To develop and test liver cancer prevention educational material.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 18 years old
* Participants at the HOPE Clinic
* Able to speak and read either English or Spanish
* For usability testing: Able to use and navigate websites on own smart phone or study computer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Has been diagnosed with liver cancer
* Cannot provide consent or otherwise participate in research activities (e.g. vision or hearing impairment)
